crossRefs.note: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

but don’t stay there. Pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Don’t allow them to enter into their cities…

Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth…
Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!

For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

people.name: Barak
people.line: An Israelite commander who defeated Canaanite forces with Deborah.

people.name: Sisera
people.line: Canaanite commander defeated by Deborah and Barak.

translations.web: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.
translations.bsb: Then Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth-hagoyim, and the whole army of Sisera fell by the sword; not a single man was left.
translations.kjv: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
translations.asv: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword; there was not a man left.
